title: Guardrail frontmatter
description: YAML frontmatter required at the top of every guardrail markdown file. Keep this small and flat — it is what gets loaded into registry/guardrail-index.yaml for cheap lookup, so every field here is a lookup/filter key, not prose.

id.description: Stable id, e.g. GR-MD-CYBER-001. Never reused, even if the guardrail is retired.

vertical.description: Matches a folder under verticals/, or 'cross-cutting' for shared rules.

lifecycle_phase.description: When in the Speckit pipeline this guardrail should be loaded.

binding_tier.description: binding = hard regulatory/legal requirement, agent should block. advisory = best practice, agent should flag and continue.

source.description: Human-readable citation, e.g. 'FDA Guidance: Cybersecurity in Medical Devices (Sept 2023)'.

version.description: Version of the *source regulation/guidance*, not of this file.

supersedes.description: id of a guardrail this one replaces, if any.

related_ids.description: Other guardrail ids this one traces to, depends on, or conflicts with. Mirrored into registry/relationships.yaml with the edge type.

applicability_tags.description: Tags an agent matches against task/spec context, e.g. ['software-as-medical-device', 'connected-device'].

owner.description: Team or role accountable for this content's accuracy (see governance/CONTENT-OWNERS.md), not the engineer who wrote the file.

summary.description: One or two sentences. This is what gets shown in INDEX.md and the registry — write it so an agent can decide relevance WITHOUT opening the file.
